purpose: Increase useful local work between external I/O boundaries without adding a new scheduler, queue, CURRENT, authority primitive, or per-subtask durable row.

preservation_contract.requested_delta: Bundle a related block of local reasoning/verification under one existing owned job, then persist one result artifact and one RETURN.
forbidden_regressions: one durable row per local subtask
claiming DONE with missing required evidence
stopping after one productive unit in POOL

experiment_or_test.control: Current v3.30 owned-job pipeline with normal durable lifecycle
experiment_or_test.candidate: Same authority/pipeline with a local MACRO_BATCH inside E5/E6 and one bundled result persist
metrics: server-clock primary completion and reallocation when available

promotion_gate: Independent reproduction across multiple fresh workers
Lower material-result I/O per useful local decision than a micro-write baseline
Server/external timing used for performance conclusions
preservation_contract.rollback: Ignore this candidate artifact; binding WORKER_PIPELINE_V1 and CURRENT are unchanged.
preservation_contract.truth_boundary: Candidate evidence only. It does not alter WORKER_PIPELINE, allocator, CURRENT, Human Accepted, or Served.

entry_conditions: Durable authority already exists for one exact owned job.
All bundled subtasks fit that job's authority and definition_of_done.
No bundled subtask independently requires human approval or a different exclusive owner.
Required capabilities are compatible or explicit boundaries are already known.

task_bundle.required_task_failure: bundle cannot return DONE until repaired or classified BOUNDARY/PARTIAL

local_checkpoints.pass_when: all required local tasks have outcome or explicit boundary
every definition-of-done row maps to evidence/check
no contradictions, missing required fields, false PASS, or authority widening

groups: mandatory Design DNA bundle when implicated

external_waits.rule: never poll/sleep for local cognition; explicit external dependency becomes WAIT/BOUNDARY

external_io_budget.reallocation_io: separate continuation budget after counted RETURN

durable_checks: canonical RETURN references exact candidate and authority

failure_semantics.local_required_failure: repair locally or return PARTIAL/BOUNDARY; never DONE
failure_semantics.external_read_failure: record exact missing evidence and boundary if required; unknown is not PASS
failure_semantics.return_write_failure: E7 BOUNDARY; durable candidate alone does not count productive unit
failure_semantics.context_or_scope_overflow: split only the concrete residual into a normal bounded successor if authorized
failure_semantics.stale_or_generation_conflict: normal recovery/fencing laws win; macro batching grants no exception

next_step_selection.after_done: refresh compact frontier and reallocate under same worker_id
next_step_selection.successor_rule: at most one concrete non-duplicate residual on terminal stop; never one successor per local subtask

decisions.decision: MACRO_BATCH is post-ownership execution packaging only; it does not replace allocator, PIN, claim, CURRENT, scheduler, or worker identity.
Bundle only related subtasks already covered by one owned job and one authority scope; cross-owner or independently effectful work stays separate.
Represent local subtasks ephemerally with task_id, question, dependencies, required_evidence, outcome, and notes; do not create durable job rows for local reasoning steps.
Resolve an acyclic dependency order locally; a dependent subtask cannot PASS from an unresolved prerequisite.
SCOPE_LOCK freezes authority, source refs, non-goals, and acceptance rows before deep reasoning.
DECISION_COMPLETE requires every required local subtask to have a concrete outcome or explicit boundary before persistence.
EVIDENCE_MAP binds every owned definition-of-done row to a local check or durable evidence target.
FINAL_AUDIT runs once across the complete bundle for contradictions, missing required fields, ungrounded claims, and forbidden authority expansion.
Local checkpoints are memory-only by default. Heartbeats remain separate liveness signals; checkpoint state is not written per subtask.

If a branch requires independent mutation authority, human approval, incompatible capability, or cannot fit the bounded context, split only that concrete residual into a normal durable successor rather than exploding every local step into jobs.

After ownership, read only the exact job source, its named evidence, mandatory preservation/DNA context when implicated, and the prewrite freshness pair. Coalesce compatible reads into bounded groups.

Subtask material writes are zero. The macro result persists as one candidate/result artifact plus the canonical RETURN; mandatory beacon/PIN/claim/STARTED/heartbeat telemetry remain separately measured lifecycle I/O.
Local cognition never polls or sleeps. External WAIT is explicit runtime dependency state and must not be hidden inside local work duration.

Verification is evidence-map-first: required rows must be PASS or truthful BOUNDARY; JSON/shape checks and cross-decision consistency are local when possible, independent reproduction is required before promotion.
A failed required local subtask makes the bundle PARTIAL/FAIL until repaired; sibling reasoning may continue only when dependency-safe, but the bundle cannot claim DONE.

If the candidate write fails, no DONE RETURN is permitted. If candidate persists but RETURN cannot, E7 remains a transport boundary and the unit does not count productive until canonical RETURN is durable.
One result_bundle carries decisions, defects, evidence refs, tests, measurements with null/unknown semantics, unresolved items, and exact next-action selection.
Server/connector timestamps and durable commit refs are external clock evidence. Model-authored/self-reported durations are diagnostic only and never promoted to wall-clock.
After durable RETURN, re-enter the compact frontier under the same worker_id. Do not create a successor merely to improve metrics; relay at most one concrete residual when the worker must stop.
Do not promote a universal numeric batch size from one canary. Use >=12 related local decisions here; test a 12–24 decision exploration range in later controlled canaries before any binding change.

defects_detected.finding: Lifecycle I/O and task-result I/O are easy to conflate; measuring only total writes would punish required authority evidence and obscure the target optimization.
defects_detected.repair: Report lifecycle/authority, context, material-result, verification, reallocation, and telemetry I/O as separate buckets.

defects_detected.finding: 'Local checkpoint' can be misread as a durable heartbeat/checkpoint write, recreating the per-subtask GitHub churn the experiment is meant to remove.
defects_detected.repair: Mark local checkpoints memory_only=true and keep heartbeat policy independent.

defects_detected.finding: One visible orchestration/tool call can fan out into several connector operations, and a failed grouped call may obscure which backend reads completed.
defects_detected.repair: Report visible tool-call groups exactly when countable; report connector-operation count as null/unknown unless the runtime exposes complete per-operation telemetry.

defects_detected.finding: Bundling unrelated tasks could hide scope or capability boundaries and recreate a mini-scheduler inside one worker.
defects_detected.repair: Admission requires one existing owned scope; cross-owner/effectful/capability-separated work must remain normal durable jobs.

defects_detected.finding: Self-reported elapsed seconds in local-only experiments are not an external performance clock.
defects_detected.repair: Use server comment/commit timestamps or dedicated external clock evidence; preserve self-reported durations only as diagnostic data.

comparison_with_WORKER_LOCAL_CAPACITY_V2.identity_finding: A generated replica_id collided across two conversations; external identity must remain durable and de-novo.
comparison_with_WORKER_LOCAL_CAPACITY_V2.timing_boundary: Self-reported durations 56..432s are diagnostic only and are not external wall-clock telemetry.
comparison_with_WORKER_LOCAL_CAPACITY_V2.interpretation: The checkpoint supports sustained local work capacity and motivates fewer I/O boundaries. It does not prove this candidate faster; this canary preserves durable external identity/authority while batching local reasoning.

measurements.github_connector_operations_exact_reason: At least one grouped connector call failed as a unit while individual backend reads may have partially completed; complete per-operation telemetry is not exposed here.
measurements.wall_clock_reason: No independent complete external wall-clock interval was measured for the local decision block.

External wall-clock primary-complete and reallocation latency should be captured by server/runtime instrumentation, not worker self-report.
